evals.prompt: 현재 feature/S15P11B104-201-profile-ui 브랜치에서 프로필 카드 화면을 구현 중이야. 화면 모양은 다 정해졌으니 바로 구현해줘. 아직 카드를 눌렀을 때 동작은 설명하지 않았어.
evals.expected_output: The skill recognizes clear UI work without requesting design materials or broad repository inspection and asks one plain-language question about what the user should see after pressing the profile card.
expectations: The response starts the interaction interview without asking whether this is UI work.
No Figma, screenshot, design document, screen inventory, full diff, or broad specification review is requested.
Exactly one question is asked.
The question asks what the user should see after pressing the profile card.
Two or three distinct user-visible outcomes and a direct-input option are offered.
Unexplained implementation terms such as modal, bottom sheet, routing, dismiss, or toggle are not used as standalone choices.

evals.prompt: 게시물 작성 화면을 만드는 중이야. 작성 버튼을 누르면 새 화면으로 이동하고, 완료하면 피드로 돌아가. 제출 중 중복 클릭이나 실패 처리는 일반적인 방식으로 알아서 해줘.
evals.expected_output: The skill recognizes that the material interactions are already decided, applies safe conventional submission behavior without further questions, and returns a compact summary separating confirmed behavior from conventionally selected behavior.
expectations: No follow-up question is asked.
The confirmed behavior includes moving to the writing screen and returning to the feed after completion.
The conventionally selected behavior prevents repeated submission while processing.
The conventionally selected failure behavior preserves the user's input and allows another attempt.
The response is a compact summary rather than a long requirements document.

evals.prompt: 현재 UI 브랜치에서 설정 화면 제목의 글자 크기와 위아래 간격만 디자인 시안에 맞춰 수정해줘. 클릭 동작이나 화면 이동은 바뀌지 않아.
evals.expected_output: The skill identifies a pure visual adjustment with no interaction gap and does not start an interview.
expectations: No interaction question is asked.
No confirmation of UI-work status is requested.
No new interaction, navigation, error-handling, or state requirement is invented.
The response allows the original styling task to proceed immediately.

evals.prompt: 현재 feature/S15P11B104-202-profile-ui 브랜치야. 화면 작업은 잠시 멈추고 이번에는 프로필 조회 API 응답 형식만 정리해줘.
evals.expected_output: The skill treats the current request as non-UI work even though the branch name mentions UI and does not start an interaction interview.
expectations: No UI interaction question is asked.
The UI-looking branch name is not used by itself to override the explicit API task.
No screen behavior, navigation, or visual requirement is invented.
The response allows the API response-format task to proceed.

evals.prompt: 설정 화면의 회원 탈퇴 버튼을 구현 중이야. 누른 뒤 삭제 처리는 알아서 일반적으로 해줘.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not choose a destructive deletion flow on the user's behalf and asks one plain-language question that distinguishes confirmation and consequence behavior.
expectations: Exactly one question is asked.
The skill does not immediately decide or execute account deletion.
The question describes user-visible confirmation or cancellation behavior without relying on the standalone term modal.
The choices make the irreversible consequence understandable.
No unrelated UI or implementation detail is requested.
